# Frontend (Angular)

## Stack & Conventions
- Angular **21** standalone, zoneless via `provideZonelessChangeDetection`
- Signals for state (`signal`, `computed`, `toSignal`), `inject()` for DI, and separate `.ts` / `.html` / `.scss` files per component
- New control flow syntax (`@if`, `@for`, `@switch`), Material 21 + Tailwind, Axios HTTP client
- TypeScript `lib: es2022`; typed Reactive Forms remain the default
- No SSR: the app is authenticated and browser/MSAL-heavy

## Structure
- `core/` — layout/shell (navigation, footer)
- `shared/` — services, facades, guards, enums, interfaces, design-system components
- `features/` — feature pages (lazy-loaded)
- `environments/` — API base URLs

## Shell Navigation [2026-05-13]
- The app shell now has a true global vs contextual sidebar split via `SidebarContextService`: global mode exposes top-level navigation plus docs/favorites/recent items, while project/config modes group links into `Define`, `Generate`, and `Manage` sections.
- User-level preferences at `/settings` must stay reachable even when the sidebar is in project/config contextual mode. The shell-level entry point now lives in the topbar (`NavigationComponent`) as a dedicated settings shortcut next to help, so display preferences such as app dark/light theme and Bicep viewer themes remain discoverable from any screen.
- In project context, the `Generate` section should list the project-level `Génération` entry before the repository/layout `Configuration` entry so artifact generation stays the primary action and setup remains the secondary follow-up.
- Contextual sidebar links now deep-link into detail tabs through the shared `tab` query-param contract in `src/Front/src/app/shared/enums/detail-route-tabs.ts`: project detail keeps `/projects/:id` as the default `Configurations` tab and maps `environments`, `naming`, `members`, `variables`, and `settings`; config detail keeps `/config/:id` as the default `Resources` tab and maps `tags` and `naming`. The sidebar template must forward `queryParams` so only the matching entry stays active. The old project `repositories` tab/query is retired; stale `?tab=repositories` URLs should be normalized away with `replaceUrl` and fall back to the default tab.
- The shell sidebar is now fixed at `240px` through the shared CSS variable `--ifs-sidebar-width`; the collapse toggle, `SidebarStateService`, and the old `ifs.sidebar.collapsed` localStorage preference were removed so left navigation always stays fully visible.
- `PageContextService` is the shared breadcrumb contract between feature pages and the top navigation bar; pages own the current breadcrumb and must clear it when leaving their context.
- The footer status bar now exposes version, environment, and legal/docs/status links; keep those links as shell-level concerns rather than scattering them across feature pages.

## Containerization & Build
- `src/Front/Dockerfile` builds with `node:22-alpine`, injects `API_URL` into `environment.ts`, uses a BuildKit cache on `/root/.npm`, and serves the production build from `nginx:1.29-alpine` with a `/` healthcheck
- `src/Front/nginx.conf` listens on `8080`, gzips JS/CSS/JSON/SVG/XML, serves hashed assets with 1-year `immutable` cache, and falls back to `index.html` for Angular routing
- `src/Front/.dockerignore` excludes `node_modules`, `dist`, and `.angular`
- `src/Front/src/index.html` no longer pulls Roboto or Material Icons from Google Fonts. Angular now bundles `@fontsource/roboto` (weights 300/400/500) and `material-icons` through the `angular.json` styles arrays so `mat-icon` ligatures keep working without external stylesheet dependencies.
- Build budgets: `anyComponentStyle` warning/error = `56 kB` / `64 kB`; `initial` warning/error = `1.2 MB` / `1.3 MB`
- Production `npm run build` now exits `0` with the current Angular 21 bundle size; remaining warnings are limited to OpenTelemetry CommonJS/ESM optimization bailouts.
- Browser tab icons use versioned assets in `src/index.html`: `public/ifs-favicon.svg`, `public/ifs-favicon.png`, plus regenerated `public/favicon.ico`

## i18n (FR/EN)
- `@ngx-translate/core` + `@ngx-translate/http-loader` v17 with dictionaries in `public/i18n/fr.json` and `public/i18n/en.json`
- `LanguageService` is signal-based with localStorage persistence and fallback order `persisted -> navigator.language -> fr`
- `resource-edit/dns-instructions-dialog` must not render the backend English `title` / `description` payload verbatim for supported custom-domain resource types. The dialog now localizes step copy client-side from `RESOURCE_EDIT.CUSTOM_DOMAINS.DNS_DIALOG_STEPS.*` using the known `resourceType`, while keeping the backend strings only as a fallback.
- `UserPreferencesService` now owns browser-local display preferences under localStorage key `infra-flow-sculptor.user-preferences`; the first durable preference is `bicepViewerTheme`, configured from `features/settings/settings.component.*` and consumed by `shared/components/bicep-file-panel/` through a signal-driven `data-theme` + CSS-variable skin. Keep future viewer/display preferences centralized in this service instead of scattering component-level localStorage calls.
- The `/settings` page now keeps the display-preferences UX fully on DS surfaces: application-theme cards use explicit icon sizing to avoid clipped Material ligatures, Bicep-theme cards embed a local `main.bicep` preview that mirrors the viewer's syntax-color variables, and the PAT list is rendered with `app-ds-table` plus typed cell templates instead of legacy `ifs-data-table` markup.
- `resource-edit` dialog keys stay under `RESOURCE_EDIT.*`; missing nested keys render raw labels
- `DeploymentConfigComponent` resolves ACR labels through `RESOURCE_EDIT.FIELDS.*`; missing `ACR_AUTH_MODE*` keys in one locale break the shared ACR UI
- Multi-repo project screens consume `PROJECT_DETAIL.LAYOUT.*`; `GenerationBoardComponent` reads labels from `PROJECT_DETAIL.BOARD.*`, not `CONFIG_DETAIL.BOARD.*`
- `ProjectService.getProjectLatestGeneration(...)` must treat only HTTP `404` as “no generation available”. Auth, server, and network failures must propagate so `ProjectDetailGenerationWorkflowService` can surface a real error state instead of silently pretending there is no latest generation.
- Contextual sidebar config mode must stay aligned with `CONFIG_DETAIL_ROUTE_TABS`: `cross-config-refs` and `variables` need explicit sidebar entries to preserve the active state once config tabs are URL-driven, while the `git` sidebar entry should appear only for MultiRepo projects. If a non-MultiRepo config lands on `?tab=git`, normalize the URL back to the default tab instead of leaving an impossible active-state combination.
- In config sidebar context, the `Génération` entry must navigate to the canonical project page `/projects/:projectId/generate` whenever the configuration knows its `projectId`; keep `/config/:id/generate` only as a legacy bridge route that resolves the config via `InfraConfigService` and redirects to the project page, falling back to `/config/:id` if the lookup fails.
- The standalone route `/projects/:id/generate` uses a centered DS page layout with `app-ds-page-header`, summary metric cards, and DS repository cards, but it must stay wired to `ProjectDetailGenerationWorkflowService`: the main CTA generates Bicep/Pipeline/Bootstrap artifacts, the mono-repo explorer reuses `app-bicep-file-panel`, SplitInfraCode reuses `SplitGenerationSwitcherComponent`, and the target repositories cards no longer render the old per-config list at the bottom.
- `GenerationBoardComponent` no longer embeds `LayoutRepositoriesComponent` nor the legacy `.repo-card__subtitle` / `.repo-card__details` identity rows directly on `/projects/:id/generate`; topology editing is exposed through the `Configurer` action that navigates to `/projects/:id/generate/config`, so focused board specs must assert that entry point instead of the old embedded layout editor markup.
- The standalone route `/projects/:id/generate` should expose only one visible `Générer toutes les configurations` CTA at a time: keep the ready-state action inside the lower empty-state card, while the top toolbar keeps only secondary actions such as `Push to Git` when that action is applicable.
- The ready-state empty card on `/projects/:id/generate` now uses a dedicated `board__ready-actions` flex wrapper with an explicit gap for its DS buttons, so the primary `Générer toutes les configurations` CTA and the optional `Afficher la dernière génération` action never render glued together.
- When `/projects/:id/generate` displays artifacts loaded from `getProjectLatestGeneration(...)`, `GenerationBoardComponent` must show a dedicated `app-ds-banner` above the generation panel. The banner uses the backend `generatedAt` timestamp formatted through `LanguageService.currentLanguage()`, and it offers a clear “generate again” CTA. Any fresh project-level generation must clear this historical-generation context immediately so the banner disappears as soon as the user relaunches generation.
- `GetProjectLatestGenerationResponse.generatedAt` does not arrive as ISO in the frontend: the backend exposes the generation folder timestamp in compact `yyyyMMddHHmmss` form. The historical-generation banner formatter in `generation-board.component.ts` must therefore parse that compact timestamp explicitly before handing it to `Intl.DateTimeFormat`, otherwise the UI falls back to the raw digits such as `20260516133039`.
- The standalone route `/projects/:id/generate` is also the only project-level surface for editing layout/repository topology. Reuse `layout-repositories/LayoutRepositoriesComponent` there instead of keeping a separate `Layout & dépôts` tab in `project-detail`; the project sidebar should therefore expose only the `Génération` entry for that workflow and stop linking to the removed `?tab=repositories` query.
- The standalone route `/projects/:id/generate` must also call `SidebarContextService.setProjectContext(project.id, project.name)` after loading the project; otherwise the contextual sidebar can keep a stale project id and the `Génération` entry will not highlight on direct navigation or refresh.
- On `/projects/:id/configuration`, `LayoutRepositoriesComponent` must treat layout-preset card selection as an optimistic local signal, invalidate `ProjectService`'s project cache before reloading after `setLayoutPreset(...)`, and emit state back to `GenerationConfigComponent` so the summary cards update immediately and roll back cleanly if the save fails. The same child-to-parent sync must cover repository add/edit/delete: after a repository dialog save or repository deletion, invalidate the cached project snapshot before reload and emit the refreshed `ProjectResponse` back to the page so repository counts and layout cards do not stay stale for up to the cache TTL.
- `ProjectService` and `InfraConfigService` now own cache invalidation for successful write operations that mutate project/config read models. Components should rely on those service-level invalidations rather than re-implementing scattered local cache busting after every mutation.
- On `/projects/:id/generate`, `SplitInfraCode` target repositories must be derived directly from `project.repositories` (infra slot + code slot), not from config grouping on `repos[0]`; otherwise the board can collapse both slots into a single visible card when one alias is first in the list.
- On `/projects/:id/generate`, repository cards should expose the clickable `owner/repository` identity only once inside the header; do not repeat it again in a separate `URL` detail row. In `SplitInfraCode`, the code repository card must use code-oriented metrics (`Applications`, pipeline scope/shared-pipeline indicators) instead of repeating the infra resource totals, and provider/content-kind chips should stay grouped in the header rather than drifting into a detached bottom tag row.
- On `/projects/:id/generate`, keep the mono-repo Bicep / Pipeline / Bootstrap tabs driven by a small typed local config instead of three near-cloned template branches. The shared tab shell must own the common download/loading/error/viewer states, while Bootstrap keeps its dedicated guide card and uses its own `PROJECT_DETAIL.BOOTSTRAP.DOWNLOADING` busy label.
- `shared/components/bicep-file-panel/` is also the reference seam for accessibility polish on generated-file viewers: keep the “back to file list” action at AA contrast against the viewer chrome, even when it uses an accent-tinted surface.
- The PowerShell source-vs-dictionary scan still reports `_`-suffixed dynamic prefixes such as `HOME.RECENT.TYPE_`; those are not true missing leaves

## Auth & Frontend Services
- `@azure/msal-browser@^5` only; no `@azure/msal-angular`
- `MsalAuthService` lazy-inits `PublicClientApplication`, uses `loginRedirect()`, and sets the active account explicitly after `handleRedirectPromise()`
- `MsalAuthService` also exposes `getAccessTokenForScopesSilently(scopes)` for UI-only delegated-scope fetches that must not trigger an interactive prompt during shell render; `NavigationComponent` uses `MicrosoftGraphProfilePhotoService` + Graph `User.Read` on `/me/photo/$value` to hydrate the header avatar and falls back to initials when no token/photo is available
- `MicrosoftGraphProfilePhotoService` returns the raw photo `Blob` (not a prebuilt `blob:` URL). `NavigationComponent` owns `URL.createObjectURL(...)` / `URL.revokeObjectURL(...)` so the blob URL lifecycle stays explicit at the UI layer.
- `AxiosService` now routes both backend `401` responses and missing-token preflight failures through a single guarded redirect helper to `/login`; it avoids duplicate redirects and transient component-level error banners
- API services are `providedIn: 'root'` wrappers over `AxiosService.request$<T>()`

## Visual & Design System Baseline [2026-04-24]
- Signature look: app background `linear-gradient(135deg, #1a237e 0%, #0288d1 50%, #00bcd4 100%)`, glassy cards (`rgba(255,255,255,0.08)` + blur), and cyan CTA gradients
- SCSS tokens and mixins live under `src/Front/src/scss/`; `angular.json` exposes `src` as a style include path and Tailwind extends the same `ifs-*` palette, radii, shadows, and gradients
- The DS surface includes page/layout primitives (`app-ds-button`, `app-ds-card`, `app-ds-alert`, shared headers) plus CVA-based form controls (`app-ds-text-field`, `app-ds-textarea`, `app-ds-select`, `app-ds-toggle`, `app-ds-checkbox`, `app-ds-radio-group`, `app-ds-chip`, `app-ds-icon-button`)
- `src/Front/src/styles.scss` applies a global Material override so untouched Material components still inherit the project brand
- Most buttons, toggles, and form fields were migrated during the Angular 21 / DS waves; remaining raw `mat-form-field` cases are intentional where DS controls do not cover `matAutocomplete`, detached submit buttons, or `viewChild`-driven input editing
- `DsSelectComponent` renders via `cdkConnectedOverlay`; `DsToggleComponent` exposes `ariaLabel` and is the standard toggle used by `ToggleSectionCardComponent`

## Config Detail Git Tab Visibility [2026-04-25]
- In `config-detail`, the `Git` tab is visible only when `project.layoutPreset === 'MultiRepo'`.
- Config-level `Generate` / `Push to Git` actions are also visible only for true `MultiRepo` projects; `AllInOne` and `SplitInfraCode` reserve those actions to `project-detail`.
- The `Git` tab now mirrors the project-level layout/repository UX for configuration sub-modes: the chooser uses the same preset-card visual pattern as `project-detail`, and the repository bindings render with the same `repo-card` / `slot-empty` card language.
- Changing a configuration sub-mode (`AllInOne` / `SplitInfraCode`) updates the local signal optimistically before the refetch, so the click has immediate visible feedback instead of waiting for the round-trip.

## DS Constraints & Shared Components
- `app-ds-button` does **not** forward `form="<id>"`; keep native buttons for detached submit triggers such as `add-config-dialog`
- DS form controls are CVA-first: prefer `formControlName`; for ad hoc inputs use standalone `ngModel`
- `TranslateService.instant()`-built `DsSelectOption[]` labels are not reactive on language switch; showcase controls using `formControlName` must stay under a local `[formGroup]`
- `ProjectsComponent` keeps its sort dropdown as a computed signal keyed by `LanguageService.currentLanguage()`, and its card navigation uses a full-card native `<a>` overlay with the favorite icon button kept as a separate interactive layer. This preserves live language switching and avoids `role="link"` accessibility regressions.
- `DeploymentConfigComponent` centralizes deployment mode, ACR selection, and UAI/ACR diagnostics UX
- `ToggleSectionCardComponent` wraps premium toggleable sections and is reused by ACA health-probe configuration
- `ConfirmDialogComponent` and `EditAbbreviationDialogComponent` are shared cross-feature dialogs
- `DockerfilePickerComponent` is a standalone signal-based overlay (`cdkConnectedOverlay`) that lets the user browse a code repo for Dockerfiles (branch selector → file list → auto-fill path); reused across ContainerApp, WebApp, and FunctionApp pipeline tabs. Keep it rendered whenever container mode is active, and gate interactivity with optional `projectId` / disabled state instead of an outer `@if`, otherwise lazy-tab signal timing can hide the picker entirely. [2026-04-26]

## Feature UX Conventions
- **Project creation wizard [2026-04-25/26]:** the layout-preset step renders preset icons through standard Angular Material `<mat-icon>` instead of raw `material-symbols-outlined` spans, because the latter can visibly fall back to literal icon names in this app shell. The wizard dialog opens at `960px` with `maxWidth: 96vw`, and `.ifs-wizard-dialog` adds scoped stepper-header spacing plus wrapped labels so the 4/5-step header remains readable. The stepper state layer is now tuned locally through Material stepper CSS variables so hover/focus on completed steps stays as a softer rounded pill instead of touching the full header rail, and the three preset cards are equalized locally in `layout-step` rather than by changing the shared DS option-card globally. The review step uses card-style sections with DS tokens for clear visual separation. Wizard footer actions (Back/Next/Submit) are sticky at the modal bottom via flex layout on the Material stepper wrapper so they stay visible during scroll.
- **ACR auth mode:** `DeploymentConfigComponent` owns the shared selector (`ManagedIdentity` / `AdminCredentials`). `resource-edit` and `add-resource-dialog` persist `acrAuthMode`, clear it when the ACR is cleared, and bypass UAI diagnostics for admin-credentials mode
- **Resource-edit UAI flows [2026-05-11]:** `ResourceData` already exposes `resourceGroupId`, so `resource-edit.component.ts` UAI creation / KV-entry UAI creation / role-assignment dialog flows should read `res.resourceGroupId` directly. Avoid structural assertions like `as { resourceGroupId?: string }`, which only create local Sonar noise without tightening types.
- **Resource-edit Key Vault warnings [2026-05-13]:** the missing-role warning UI is now shared by `app-settings` and `config-keys` through `sections/shared/resource-edit-kv-missing-role-card.component.*`, and the duplicated controller-side identity / Key Vault access / assign-role workflow is centralized in `sections/shared/resource-edit-kv-role-assignment.helpers.ts`. Reuse those seams before adding a third Key Vault-reference section.
- **SplitGenerationSwitcher chip contrast [2026-05-11]:** keep the Infra / Code count chips on an opaque-enough accent fill. The tiny 0.67rem counter text fails Sonar contrast checks when paired with translucent pastel backgrounds over the dark switcher shell.
- **Role-assignment identity constraints [2026-05-11]:** `src/Front/src/app/shared/interfaces/role-assignment.interface.ts` must keep `AzureRoleDefinitionResponse.requiresUserAssignedIdentity` in sync with the backend contract. `add-role-assignment-dialog` and `resource-edit` must derive UAI-only role behavior from that flag, not from a hardcoded AcrPull GUID constant.
- **Name availability:** `NameAvailabilityService.check$()` runs with a debounced 500 ms `switchMap` in `resource-edit` and `add-resource-dialog` for 10 Azure-name-sensitive resource types; submit/save is blocked unless the user explicitly bypasses it
- **Add-resource environment step gating [2026-05-16]:** `add-resource-dialog` and `config-detail` now rely on the shared metadata sets `RESOURCE_TYPES_WITH_ENVIRONMENT_SETTINGS` / `RESOURCE_TYPES_WITHOUT_ENVIRONMENT_SETTINGS` plus `hasResourceTypeEnvironmentSettings(...)` from `shared/resource-metadata/resource-type.metadata.ts`. Types without real per-environment fields (for example `EventHubNamespace`, `VirtualNetwork`, `NetworkSecurityGroup`, `PrivateDnsZone`, `FrontDoor`, `UserAssignedIdentity`) must skip the environment step entirely during creation and must not surface missing-environment diagnostics afterward.
- **Container App environments:** capacity/scaling, ingress/network, and Health Probes are split into sections; probe cards use a shared equal-width 3-column grid on desktop and collapse responsively
- **App-setting dialog scroll [2026-05-11]:** `AddAppSettingDialogComponent` uses the scoped panel class `ifs-add-app-setting-dialog` plus a flex-column root so only `.as-dialog__content` owns the vertical scroll. For long dialog flows with a mode bar, title, and sticky actions, hide overflow on the Material dialog surface and keep a single explicit content viewport to avoid double scrollbars.
- **Project environment dialog scroll [2026-05-16]:** `add-project-environment-dialog` now follows the same single-viewport pattern: keep the root as a flex column shell, let only `mat-dialog-content` scroll, and keep `mat-dialog-actions` compact with aligned equal-width cancel/save actions. On small laptops, avoid `overflow: hidden` on the dialog body or oversized footer padding, otherwise the approval toggle and bottom actions clip before users can reach them.
- **Import App Settings multi-format [2026-05-11]:** `ImportAppSettingsDialogComponent` in `resource-edit/import-app-settings-dialog/` is now driven by the selected application context (`resourceType`, `deploymentMode`, `runtimeStack`) passed from `resource-edit`. The dialog chooses a recommended import mode automatically: WebApp .NET -> `appsettings.json`, FunctionApp -> `local.settings.json`, Java WebApp -> `application.properties`, container/Python/Node/PHP -> `.env`; users can still override to supported formats (`.json`, `.env`, `.properties`, `.yml`, `.yaml`). Parsing is centralized in `import-app-settings-parser.ts` with a focused Karma spec covering mode resolution + JSON/.env/properties/YAML parsing. The 3-step flow remains: upload/drag-drop or paste content, board with per-variable source selection (static/output/pipeline variable group/skip), then sequential API import with progress bar via existing `POST /azure-resources/{id}/app-settings`. i18n keys remain under `RESOURCE_EDIT.IMPORT_APP_SETTINGS.*`.
- **Project environments tab [2026-05-15]:** `project-detail` should keep `environmentDefinitions` in the dedicated `environments-section/project-detail-environments-section.component.*` slice rather than re-expanding that markup inside the parent. The intended UX is a stacked full-width panel per environment with grouped sections (`Overview`, `Naming`, `Governance`, `Tags`) and shared parent callbacks for add/edit/delete; avoid reintroducing the old compact `env-card` / connector strip layout.
- **Project environments visual density [2026-05-15]:** the full-width environment panels should keep a strong header hierarchy (meta chips, title, subscription subline), a compact summary for ARM connection + tag count, denser fact cards inside grouped sections, and split tag key/value pills. The goal is to avoid wide empty blocks on desktop while staying readable and responsive in the existing dark enterprise theme.
- **Project environments header inset [2026-05-15]:** the top chips and environment title should not sit directly against the outer panel border. Keep them inside an inner header surface (`environment-panel__hero`) with its own padding and subtle gradient, so the header reads as a composed block on desktop and stacks cleanly on mobile.
- **Project environments surface spacing [2026-05-15]:** after the header inset landed, the environment panel still needed stronger global breathing room. Keep a consistent inset across the outer panel, hero summary cards, grouped sections, fact cards, and tag pills so no text cluster reads against a border on desktop while mobile falls back to `16px` panel/group padding.
- **Project environments hero/content separation [2026-05-16]:** keep an explicit extra gap between the top environment identity block (`environment-panel__hero`) and the lower `Overview` / `Naming` / `Governance` cards. The tag pill inside the `Tags` section also needs a roomier inset so values like `ENVIRONMENT : dev` do not read against the chip border.
- **Project-detail settings titles [2026-05-16]:** local Settings-tab headings such as `Tags` and `Agent Pool` must align icon + label inside the heading itself (`settings-section__title` as inline-flex with centered items), otherwise the raw inline `mat-icon` drifts vertically against the text even when the outer row already uses flex.
- **Environment editor categorization:** 13 resource editors use `env-extra-section` groups. ContainerRegistry and EventHubNamespace remain uncategorized; this added 38 `RESOURCE_EDIT.FIELDS.*` i18n keys in both locales
- **Existing-resource diagnostics:** generation preflight checks in `config-detail` and `project-detail` must ignore `resource.isExisting` items when computing missing-environment warnings
- **Existing-resource create contracts [2026-05-15]:** `add-resource-dialog-resource-submitter.service.ts` forwards `common.isExisting` for Web Apps just like the sibling create flows, so `CreateWebAppRequest` in `shared/interfaces/web-app.interface.ts` must keep `isExisting?: boolean` in sync with the backend/frontend contract.
- **Add-resource submitter fallback [2026-05-16]:** `add-resource-dialog-resource-submitter.service.ts` must never fall through to a silent success when a `ResourceTypeEnum` is exposed in the picker but not yet wired in the submitter. The reference fix is `VirtualNetwork`: call `VirtualNetworkService.create(...)` explicitly and make the `default` branch throw, otherwise `AddResourceDialogComponent` closes with `dialogRef.close(true)` even though no POST was sent and the refreshed RG list stays unchanged.
- **Generation result panels:** no visible "Generation Results" heading remains. `config-detail` exposes its compact top-right action cluster only for true `MultiRepo` projects, while `project-detail` in `SplitInfraCode` removes the close action entirely and renders a single collapse/expand button directly in the Infra/Code split header. Any fresh Bicep, Pipeline, or Bootstrap generation auto-expands the panel again so progress/output is immediately visible
- **SplitGenerationSwitcher nested tabs [2026-05-16]:** the inner `Bicep` / `Pipeline` / `Bootstrap` sub-navigation in `SplitGenerationSwitcherComponent` should reuse the same enterprise tab language as the outer `Infra` / `Code` switcher: same header surface, 40px tab height, top-rounded active tabs, restrained hover state, and underline accents per side. The generated-content area should live inside one continuous bordered panel shell attached directly under the outer rounded tab header instead of separate floating blocks, so the generation zone reads as one composed surface.
- **Mono-repo Generate All reveal [2026-05-11]:** `project-detail` defers mono-repo file-tree, error, and download-button reveal until the whole `generateAll()` batch settles. While the batch is active, each tab keeps its loader visible even if one artifact response arrives early; standalone per-artifact retries/regenerations still reveal on their own completion.
- **SplitInfraCode Generate All reveal [2026-05-16]:** `SplitGenerationSwitcherComponent` must reuse the existing project-level batch defer signal from `ProjectDetailGenerationWorkflowService` during `generateAll()`. While the defer flag is active, both `Infra` and `Code` panes keep their loaders visible and suppress partial file trees, error banners, empty states, and badge counts; once the batch settles, all split artifacts reveal together. Standalone per-artifact retries outside the batch must still reveal immediately on completion.
- **Generated file explorer ordering [2026-05-11]:** `project-detail-tree-ordering.helper.ts` centralizes the hierarchical Bicep/Pipeline path sort used by `project-detail-tree.helpers.ts` and the split tree builders inside `SplitGenerationSwitcherComponent`. Without deterministic ordering before flattening into `BicepTreeNode[]`, a later file can render visually under a sibling folder even when its backend path and `parentFolderKey` are correct.
- **Deterministic tree sorting [2026-05-11]:** `sortHierarchicalEntries(...)` must use a fixed `Intl.Collator('en', { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'variant' })` rather than raw `localeCompare()` so generated-tree ordering stays stable across browsers/locales and keeps numeric path segments in natural order.
- **Shared generated-file reader UX [2026-05-15]:** `shared/components/bicep-file-panel/` now owns the scroll behavior for all generated artifact viewers. Opening a file should smooth-scroll to the viewer section, and the viewer header must expose a localized “back to file list” action that re-expands the current file's parent folders and scrolls the active tree item back into view. Keep this behavior in the shared component instead of reimplementing page-level scroll glue in `config-detail`, `project-detail`, or `generation-board`. The viewer is also the reference seam for stale async-load guards: if users click a second file before the first `loadFile()` resolves, only the latest request may update `viewerContent`; older completions must be ignored so the UI never jumps back to an outdated file.
- **Storage children in config-detail:** Storage Account blob/queue/table children seed directly from `resource.storageSubResources` returned by `/resource-group/{id}/resources`; full `getById()` calls remain only for explicit refresh flows
- **Project naming abbreviations:** project-detail shows overrides only for resource types actually used in the project
- **Mono-repo push UX:** combined project push uses `POST /projects/{id}/push-generated-artifacts-to-git`; `SplitInfraCode` projects hide that mono-repo CTA, surface dedicated Infra and Code push buttons from `SplitGenerationSwitcherComponent`, and open `MultiRepoPushDialogComponent` in `infra` / `code` / `both` modes based on generated artifact readiness, reading `pipelineResult.{infra,app}{Common,Config}FileUris` plus Bicep/bootstrap artifacts. The split push dialog uses a dedicated `ifs-multi-repo-push-dialog` panel class with mode-aware widths (`38rem` for single infra/code, `68rem` for dual-repo) and a deliberately simple layout: no top hero band, a neutral dialog surface, and the repo card plus validation/cancel actions as the primary visual structure. In split mode, the infra push now targets `Bicep + infra pipeline + infra bootstrap`, while the code push targets `app pipeline + app bootstrap`.
- **Multi-repo push commit messages [2026-05-11]:** `MultiRepoPushDialogComponent` now requires a commit message for both infra and code pushes. The DS textarea shows the standard required marker, an always-visible hint, and an inline validation error once touched; the placeholder is now an example instead of marking the field optional.
- **Multi-repo push branch/autocomplete + button reactivity [2026-05-11]:** `MultiRepoPushDialogComponent` again loads the project-scoped Git branch list via `ProjectService.listBranches(...)`, reuses it in a `mat-autocomplete` for both infra/code branch inputs, and derives the push CTA enabled state from form-status signals rather than raw `form.valid`, so the button re-enables immediately when required commit fields become valid in zoneless mode.
- **Split download UX [2026-04-26]:** `SplitGenerationSwitcherComponent` exposes one green download CTA per outer tab. Infra now downloads a single merged ZIP built from the latest Bicep archive plus only the `infra/` slices of the pipeline and bootstrap archives; Code does the same for the `app/` slices of pipeline and bootstrap. The merged ZIPs are repo-scoped (`*-infra-artifacts.zip`, `*-code-artifacts.zip`) rather than raw union archives. Bootstrap entries are normalized to repo-relative `.azuredevops/bootstrap.pipeline.yml` through the shared frontend helper `project-generated-artifact-paths.ts`, which is also reused by the split bootstrap tree so preview and ZIP output stay aligned with the Git push convention.
- **Split bootstrap UX [2026-04-25]:** `SplitGenerationSwitcherComponent` now shows the bootstrap preview under both outer tabs in `SplitInfraCode`: infra reads `bootstrapResult.infraFileUris`, code reads `bootstrapResult.appFileUris`, and both viewers keep `infra/` / `app/` prefixes in their load URI so the bootstrap file-content endpoint resolves the correct blob bucket. The code tab adds its own setup/usage explainer and uses the dedicated `TAB_BOOTSTRAP_APP` label.
- **Bootstrap ADO UX:** project-detail shows one guide card with explicit Build Service permission steps and Azure DevOps menu paths
- **Secure parameter mapping:** `resource-edit` exposes SQL Server password mapping through `SecureParameterMappingService`, with either random generation or variable-group-backed injection
- **Custom domains:** supported only for ContainerApp, WebApp, and FunctionApp, inside per-environment panels with add-dialog preselection of the current environment
- **Custom-domain generation preflight [2026-05-16]:** both `config-detail` and project-level `/projects/:id/generate` diagnostics now query custom domains on domain-capable resources before generation. Any domain whose `dnsValidationStatus !== 'Validated'` must open the shared `GenerationDiagnosticsDialogComponent`, warn that the binding will be excluded from generated Bicep, and let users jump back to the owning resource to finish DNS setup.
- **SQL Server editor:** `resource-edit` supports version and administrator login in general settings plus per-environment TLS
- **Config/resource header identity [2026-05-16]:** `config-detail` and `resource-edit` header banners should show only the contextual overline/type plus the entity name. Do not render the raw `config.id` or `resource.id` there; the route and breadcrumb already carry enough identity, and the extra ID adds noise in the hero block.
- **Shared resource metadata boundary [2026-05-13]:** options/icons previously owned by `config-detail/enums/*` now live under `src/Front/src/app/shared/resource-metadata/`. `resource-edit`, `project-detail`, and shared dialogs/components should import shared resource metadata from there, not from `config-detail`.
- **P2 frontend decomposition [2026-05-13]:** `config-detail` and `resource-edit` now rely on extracted section/helper seams under `features/config-detail/sections/**`, `features/config-detail/helpers/**`, and `features/resource-edit/helpers/**`. Keep section-specific logic out of the parent components; the current post-P2 parent sizes are ~1447 LOC for `config-detail.component.ts` and ~1955 LOC for `resource-edit.component.ts`.
- **P3 frontend decomposition [2026-05-13]:** `add-resource-dialog` and `project-detail` now follow the same pattern: keep orchestration logic in extracted helpers/services (`add-resource-dialog-*helper.ts`, `add-resource-dialog-*service.ts`, `project-detail-generation-*`) and treat the parents as UI composition shells. The current post-P3 parent sizes are ~961 LOC for `add-resource-dialog.component.ts` and ~897 LOC for `project-detail.component.ts`.

## Frontend Pitfalls
- `onContainerRegistryChange` must patch `generalForm.containerRegistryId`; `onDeploymentModeChange` must trigger `checkAcrPullAccess()` when switching back to container mode with an ACR already selected; `isAcrEnabled` should stay the single source of truth
- `groupedRoleAssignments` must seed the assigned-UAI group even when it has zero role assignments, and the empty state must treat `assignedUserAssignedIdentity` as meaningful state
- When a resource parameter moves between general and environment config, first update the shared environment-settings metadata in `shared/resource-metadata/resource-type.metadata.ts`, then update all 3 creation-modal touchpoints: `createEnvFormGroup(type)`, `buildXxxEnvironmentSettings()`, and the HTML `@case (ResourceTypeEnum.Xxx)` block in the environments step
- The generation panel collapse state is shared at the panel level, not per tab. Reset it to `false` when a new generation starts or when the panel is fully closed, otherwise a user can launch generation and keep the loading/result content hidden accidentally
- Angular warning `NG8102` means a `??` fallback is redundant on a non-nullable expression; `TS-998113` means a standalone import remains in `imports` after the template stopped using it

## Sonar Quick Wins [2026-04-28]
- `project-generated-artifact-paths.ts` is the shared gate for combined ZIP recomposition. It now rejects absolute paths, drive-prefixed paths, `..` traversal segments, trailing-dot/space segments, backslash-based paths, and control characters before preview/download reuse the path.
- `BicepHighlightPipe` no longer bypasses Angular sanitization. The pipe still escapes the raw Bicep content, injects only the highlight `<span>` wrappers, and returns a plain HTML string for normal `[innerHTML]` sanitization.
- Local alias normalization and Storage CORS validation helpers were rewritten as bounded character-by-character parsing instead of regex-heavy transforms flagged by Sonar.
- `project-detail.component.ts` now protects combined artifact downloads with explicit compressed-source, entry-count, per-entry, and total-extracted-size limits. `JSZip.loadAsync` runs with `checkCRC32`, unsafe paths fail the download, and the UI shows `PROJECT_DETAIL.SWITCHER.DOWNLOAD_ARCHIVE_ERROR` instead of surfacing a raw exception.
- Escape-heavy parser helpers should use `String.raw` for search literals like `\n`, `\t`, `\\`, `\:` and `\=` instead of doubly escaped string literals; Sonar raises `typescript:S7780` on the latter even when behavior is identical.
- When two adjacent SCSS blocks share the same selector list (for example a shared card shell plus nested elements), keep them in a single selector block rather than repeating the selector list, otherwise Sonar raises duplicate-selector `css:S4666` findings.
